forward to it!

subject: Encord | Interested in more resources?
text:
Hey [NAME],

Noticed you recently downloaded our Physical AI e-book - so wanted to see if there was anything I could help with?

I lead the Enterprise AI team here at Encord, working with similar scale orgs (including Toyota, Siemens, Philips) - helping them to move away from open-source starter tools like CVAT + Voxel 51, and towards a more scalable Enterprise-grade data management solution.

If you found the e-book useful, would also be happy to send over some further resources detailing how we work with teams like Toyota, Siemens, and Philips - let me know if this is something you'd be interested in seeing?

subject: [NAME] - Interested in how other AV teams are using Encord?
text:

if there was anything I could help with?

I lead the AV team here at Encord, working with Woven-by-Toyota, Wayve,

in seeing?

subject: Data Development for DMS/ ADAS
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across a vehicle distance detection patent by your computer vision
team so I wanted to reach out. We've been working on projects with Woven
(Toyota), Motive and Nauto, naturally your work at [COMPANY] has been on my
radar.

We help those teams improve efficiency for training data preparations  -
e.g. finding relevant events from millions of miles of video data, as well
to automate parts of the annotation process.

I'd love to exchange perspectives on data development for DMS/ADAS if
you're open to a chat? Quite flexible between Tuesdays to Thursdays if you
have a preferred time.

subject: Multimodal Data Development for Deepfake Detection
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across the report on your image classification model so I wanted to
reach out. We work on projects with Reality Defender & Paravision for
deepfake detection model development - thought it's worth a chat.

In case Encord is new to you - we help over 200 AI teams improve data
quality for model development. We're designed for efficiency gains for
multimodal dataset preparation, with the goals of helping you bring model
with higher accuracy into production faster.

Would you be open to exchange perspectives over a virtual coffee? I'm quite
flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you have a preferred time.

subject: 2D/3D Data Development for Vehicle Inspection
text:
Hi [NAME],

I connected with your colleagues at Fyusion in the Bay Area a few months
back, and I recall your team is developing VLM & 3D damage reconstruction
for vehicle condition report. We recently launched point cloud support and
wanted to see if you're open to a virtual coffee?

In case Encord is new to you - we work w/ UVEYE and Tractable to improve
data quality at scale for computer vision vehicle inspection models. We've
designed our platform to make 2D/3D data curation and annotation 6x more
efficient.

I'd love to get your candid feedback on whether the problems we're helping
to solve might resonate? Quite flexible Tuesday to Thursday if you're up
for a chat.

subject: Encord Reconnect
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your launch of DepalOne! I imagine with the automation
capabilities expanding, you're looking to fine-tune your models with data
from customer deployments? i understand you have some familiarity with
Encord so I thought it might be worth reconnecting.

Quick recap - we help palletising robotics teams like Pickle Robot
accelerate their human-in-the-loop processes, e.g. easily identify edge
cases for model fine-tuning, as well bringing more control and visibility
for workflow orchestration.

Let me know if you're open to a catch up? happy to share some product
updates from our end. Fairly flexible Tuesday to Thursday next week if you
have a preferred time.

you have preferred time.
